title: Budget and Revenue
text:
The scatter plot below Figure 1 plots each film’s production budget against its revenue.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")


plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (million US$)")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million US$)")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Production budget against revenue (million US$)

title: Runtime and Ratings
text:
Figure 1 plots each film’s runtime against its IMDb rating.
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Runtime (minutes) against IMDb rating

title: The Bond Films
text:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")

The Bond films run from 1995 to 2021.

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million US$)")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Revenue of the Bond films over time
